text:
Maria F.: Noticing unexpected GPU charges on project `shared-research-2025` — ~12.4k this month, no team label, attaching export.
CostBot: Uploaded invoice CSV to s3://billing/2026/03/shared-research-2025-gpus.csv
Alex B.: Can you paste the GCP project id + billingAccount? I'll run a label scan and quick audit.
Maria F.: proj: shared-research-2025, billingAccount: BA-9987. Label scan shows `team` missing and `owner` missing.
Lee C.: That project was spun up for the sandbox LLM evals. We had a one-off job that may have used preemptible pools without tags.
Priya S.: Finance can reallocate, but we need an owner sign-off and documented rationale to move charges. Maria, can you break down spend by day for the affected period?
Maria F.: Daily CSV snippet attached — bulk on Mar 10-13. I'll drop it to shared drive and link.
Sam G.: I approve reallocations <= $15k to internal groups if infra confirms source and owner signs off. Keep ledger entries.
Alex B.: Quick audit cmd: `gcloud compute instances list --project=shared-research-2025 --format="csv(name,labels)"` returned instances with empty labels. Opening PR to add org policy to block untagged GPU instances.
Priya S.: I'll create a budget alert rule: fire if any project records untagged GPU spend > $2k/day and notify finance+eng-alerts.
CostBot: Alert created: "untagged-gpu-spend-2k-day" linked to TICKET-5121
Lee C.: Confirmed the job belonged to ml-evals team; will post fix and add owner tag retroactively where possible.
Maria F.: Thanks. Once Lee drops confirmation, I'll apply manual allocation on the Mar invoice and attach Sam's approval here for audit. Leaving thread as record. :white_check_mark:
